from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-6a98a4e8.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    if not height:
        return []
    width = len(grid[0])
    marks = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and row[0] != 0 and all(x == row[0] for x in row)]
    period = len(marks)
    pattern = [0] * period
    for r, color in marks:
        pattern[r % period] = color
    return [[pattern[r % period]] * width for r in range(height)]
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path, program_path.read_text())
